description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית
description.summary: This table outlines conditions related to mergers, amalgamations, and take-overs as they affect professional liability insurance coverage. It details how coverage is impacted by such events and the requirements for extending coverage to other involved businesses.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות, במיוחד במקרים של מיזוג, איחוד או רכישה של העסק המבוטח. הפוליסה מכסה אירועים שהתרחשו לפני תאריך האפקטיבי של המיזוג, האיחוד או הרכישה. כדי להרחיב את הכיסוי לחברה אחרת, נדרשת הסכמה מפורשת בכתב מהמבטח, בתנאים מוסכמים. מיזוג, איחוד ורכישה הם אירועים מרכזיים המשפיעים על תוקף הפוליסה. פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית זו מיועדת ליועצי השקעות.
notable_values: Merger: Coverage applies to events prior to effective date
Amalgamation: Coverage applies to events prior to effective date
Take-over: Coverage applies to events prior to effective date
Additional coverage: Requires written insurer agreement

If the business of the assured shall be merged and amalgamated with some other concern or  if  the  business  of  some  other  concern  shall  be  consolidated  with  the  business  of  the Assured or if the business of the Assured shall become a party to a take-over, then the cover provided under this policy is amended to apply only to an event committed prior to the effective date of the said merger, amalgamation or take over. There shall be no cover whatsoever to the other concern or business as mentioned above unless the insurer has agreed in writing prior to the said effective date and subject to any terms and conditions as agreed by the insurer.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית
This table outlines conditions related to mergers, amalgamations, and take-overs as they affect professional liability insurance coverage. It details how coverage is impacted by such events and the requirements for extending coverage to other involved businesses.
ממדים: Event Type (Merger, Amalgamation, Take-over), Coverage Condition

5. Merger, Amalgamation, Take-over
If the business of the assured shall be merged and amalgamated with some other concern or  if  the  business  of  some  other  concern  shall  be  consolidated  with  the  business  of  the Assured or if the business of the Assured shall become a party to a take-over, then the cover provided under this policy is amended to apply only to an event committed prior to the effective date of the said merger, amalgamation or take over. There shall be no cover whatsoever to the other concern or business as mentioned above unless the insurer has agreed in writing prior to the said effective date and subject to any terms and conditions as agreed by the insurer.
